summary: Frontend-only regression of /pricing after major refactor: 4 plans consolidated into single 'Signature' flagship card at £4,495, PricingQuiz removed, FAQ spacing tightened. All 10 requested checks pass at 100%.
critical_code_review_comments: pricing.js FAQ answers 2/3/4 still reference the removed Launch/Growth/Pro/Scale plans (e.g., 'anywhere from 7 days for Launch, 14 days for Growth...'). These answers are now inconsistent with the single-Signature model and should be rewritten to match the new pricing structure.
PricingPage.jsx PAGE_TITLE/PAGE_DESCRIPTION still say 'from £99' and 'starting from just £99' — this contradicts the new single £4,495 flagship offer and should be updated for SEO consistency.
PricingCards.jsx Price component still keeps a dead 'Custom' branch (plan.price === null) which no longer applies since the Scale plan was removed — safe to prune.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified at desktop 1440x900 plus 390/820/1024/1280 viewports. Testids confirmed: plan-card-signature (1), flagship-badge, plan-price-signature ('4,495'), plan-cta-signature (href=/#contact), 13 feature items, trust line rendered, 6 FAQ items (faq-item-0..5), faq-item-5 has NO border-b while 0-4 do, first FAQ auto-open, accordion single-open toggle works, no pricing-quiz-section on page, no console errors. Price left/right gaps within card >=72px at every tested viewport — no clipping. CarePlan, AddOns (9 rows), pricing-cta-section all render. Only follow-up: content inconsistency in FAQ answers 2-4 and page meta title referencing removed plans/prices.
